june_parity.caveat: R38: membership revenue moves revenue/GM whenever goals.json carries mem keys — June parity holds ONLY when the goals payload has no mem block. R41 changed FLAG CLASSIFICATION only. R42 adds assumed install pay only on Install-bucket jobs ≤14 days old at the data-snapshot moment — mature-month rebuilds byte-identical (verified). R43 paces the three fixed monthly $ (Holiday Pay / PTO / onboarding × $4,000) by the engine's elapsedFrac — on a CLOSED month elapsedFrac=1, paced = full monthly, and the June A/B vs R42 is byte-identical (RAW modulo builtAt; 12/12 rendered panes across 4 tabs × 3 scopes; every pre-existing summary key; verified 2026-08-05 with the baseline fixed values loaded). A YOUNG window legitimately moves: Direct Labor carries only the elapsed share of the fixed $ (MTD = monthly × elapsedFrac), so mid-month GM/CP read higher — and more honest — than R42, and the Pace view carries exactly the full monthly fixed $ instead of inflating it by ÷ elapsedFrac. That is the point of R43, not drift. R44 is DISPLAY-ONLY (full-screen job card + project rollup, built on row click from the engine's own per-job records) — it cannot move any number: June A/B vs R43 verified 12/12 rendered panes byte-identical, RAW byte-identical (modulo builtAt), every summary key identical. R45 adds a per-system multiplier to the assumed install pay — it can only move jobs <=14 days old at the data-snapshot moment, so the mature-June rebuild is unchanged to the cent (verified: jobs, flag set, per-job rev/purch/labor/GM/instTop and all 71 pre-existing summary keys x 3 scopes identical; 9/12 rendered panes byte-identical, the 3 Summary panes differ ONLY by the Reconciliation label gaining 'x systems sold on the invoice'). RAW is NOT byte-identical vs R44: parseDisc now serializes a per-job `units` map (+9,745 bytes on June) — this is the one intended payload change and it is what makes the multiplier survive a saved copy. R46 is DISPLAY-ONLY (ServiceTitan deep link on every job number) and adds an OPTIONAL parser field: the 'Job ID' column of the Job Costing export is captured as job.stid and the key is ATTACHED ONLY when a real id was supplied, so an export predating the column serializes RAW byte-for-byte identically to R45. Verified on June 2026: RAW byte-identical (modulo builtAt), all 7 other data markers identical, 12/12 rendered panes (4 tabs x 3 scopes) byte-identical, every per-job record identical, every non-jobs result section identical, snap.js reproduces the ledger exactly (171 flagged / 126 HVAC / 45 Plumb / $299,421). R55 changes the MONTH-END PROJECTION ONLY (pace / gpProj / projCP): projected month-end = banked MTD + remaining Mon-Sat working days x a weighted trailing daily rate (last 6 working days x2 + prior 6 x1) instead of MTD / elapsedFrac; monthly-fixed items (Holiday/PTO/onboarding, membership, overhead) keep their full-monthly construction and the GP projection decomposition is algebraically identical to gp/elapsedFrac on the MTD fallback. A CLOSED month has zero remaining working days, so projection = actual and the June rebuild is byte-identical (verified 2026-09-29: gates 6/6 both engines, all 10 shared data markers byte-identical incl. RAW modulo builtAt, whole-output diff == template diff exactly with the footer DOM-canonicalized, 0 per-job diffs, 0 flag diffs 171=171, 0 non-pace summary diffs, snap.js ledger exact 171/126/45/$299,421.09). R55 also adds the BACKLOG splice marker (11th) - scheduled/in-progress jobs by last-appointment day with booked invoice $, display-only, null -> card hidden - which can never move a number.

release_rule: A template revision is NOT released until, in the SAME session: (1) this template.html + manifest are re-frozen in the repo, (2) the skill bundle is re-saved with the matching pp_template.html and SKILL.md, (3) the nightly task prompt carries no stale revision facts. Nightly: if the skill folder SKILL.md states a HIGHER revision than this manifest, that is a broken release — STOP and report; never silently publish the older engine.

r55.summary: Month-end pace goes banked + trailing (Stephen 2026-09-29: MTD pace trailed down over the last 2 weeks of September and over-forecast month-end). Projected month-end job revenue = banked MTD (through yesterday) + remaining Mon-Sat working days x weighted trailing daily rate ((2 x last-6-working-day revenue + 1 x prior-6) / (2x6 + 1x6) days; calendar spans cover the working-day windows so Sunday revenue still counts into the span totals). Summary tiles, P&L note, Trends pace column (renamed Month-End Pace) and trend arrows all ride the same projection; GM/CP Pace scale the job-driven flows by paceK = projJob/revJob while fixed monthly $, membership and overhead stay at full month (R38/R43 identities preserved exactly - the decomposition equals gp/elapsedFrac when paceK=1/elapsedFrac). New Summary cards: Month-end projection (headline + last-week / 2-week / old-MTD reference paces + the daily rates behind them; hidden on closed months) and Scheduled backlog (new BACKLOG marker: jobs with status Scheduled/In Progress by last_appointment_date through month-end with per-job booked invoice $ from fact_invoice_line, plus the sold-into-next-month total; booked $ is a floor - service visits are count-only until they run; display-only, never enters pace or any P&L figure; null -> hidden). Fallbacks: fewer than 1 elapsed working day or zero dated revenue -> MTD run rate (old formula); remaining=0 -> projection = actual.

r55.expect_first_build: Pace, GM-Pace and CP-Pace move to the banked + trailing projection (September verified ~2.8% below the old MTD pace at 2 days left; mid-month corrections will be larger when velocity shifts). MTD tiles, revenue, GM, flags: nothing moves. The Summary gains the projection card and - once the nightly splices BACKLOG - the scheduled-backlog card. If revenue/GM/flags change on identical inputs, that is NOT R55 - stop and flag.
